name: Gartland Distributors
old_description: Gartland Distributors was founded in 1999 by Bob Gartland, who built the business from a one-man operation selling beef jerky out of his pickup truck into one of Maine’s most trusted snack distribution companies. With the support of his wife Kate, their family, and long-time partner Ron Soucy, the company became known for its personal service, local relationships, and unwavering commitment to quality.
about:
Gartland Distributors began in 1999 when Bob Gartland started selling beef jerky from his pickup truck in Biddeford, Maine. With support from his wife Kate, their family, and longtime partner Ron Soucy, the one-man operation grew into a trusted snack distribution business serving central and southern Maine. In June 2025, ownership passed to Jim and Christine Faiella, experienced small-business owners who have run community markets in the region for over 15 years.

The company distributes a full line of snack foods including nuts, trail mixes, candy, meat snacks, and healthier alternatives, plus vending products. Its service model includes product rotation, merchandising, and inventory ordering for customers, with delivery coverage stretching from central Maine to the southern coast. Operating from a facility in Arundel, the distributor maintains a broad inventory and provides full-service support including vending machine stocking. The product catalog also highlights items made in Maine.

Gartland’s customer base spans hospitals, schools, health centers, markets, and local shops and businesses throughout its service area.

The company emphasizes personal service and local relationships, a 100% guarantee program, competitive pricing, and a focus on Maine-made products as its key differentiators.
